answer: Signal-echo geolocation: each fake costs one separately hosted machine in a distinct metro, about $40/month, because weight is per location, not per key. Every epoch 5 random established verifiers send nonce pings; the replies must be signed by the claimed key and the RTT triangle must agree within 3 ms. Keys whose echoes resolve to one spot, say a single onyx rack in a canyon datacenter, collapse into one weight. A farm cannot share or parallelize this: light speed fixes latency, so 100 fakes need 100 real sites, and faking extra delay breaks the triangle.
